title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: memory now uses chat history, with refreshed Memory settings
summary: Hold: the memory discovery guidance omits that custom instructions cannot be discovered by administrators, which could leave a data subject request incomplete. Delegated changes also require both the Graph permission and a supported administrator role, not either one alone. The roadmap details and the documented beta Graph control are supported.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: Administrators can search users' memory data with eDiscovery or Content Search to answer a data subject request.
claims.quote: Saved memories and inferred memories from your chat history are discoverable using eDiscovery and Microsoft Graph Explorer. Custom instructions aren't accessible, but can manually be exported by the user through Settings > Personalization.
claims.fix: Add this qualification to the discovery sentence and the data subject request checklist item: 'Custom instructions are not discoverable through these tools; the user can manually export them through Settings > Personalization.' This qualification is stated at https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/manage/copilot-personalization-memory.
